title: Mixed Duo #004 · 여 블랙 글래머·BollywoodGlam / 남 파워리프터·블랙 스모키 윙
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a maple avenue in full autumn colour with a pale path scattered with red and gold leaves, a standard park bench and lamp posts, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Indian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, bright golden-blonde hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a lead pyramid-shaped lump, an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold barrel-shaped weight, a silver cube-shaped block, a tin ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long copper chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop with a heavy rough copper a teardrop-shaped sinker hanging at its end, and two to three mixed-metal hair ornaments. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic (a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls), wide carved cream bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense leaf scrolls filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme white plain stiletto pumps with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Hawaiian man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, dramatic black smoky eyeshadow with sharp winged eyeliner, smooth warm bronze skin, a relaxed easygoing look with a faint smile, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large silver hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a copper round bell, a silver square-sided cowbell, a tin miniature anvil, a copper barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold rings. Extremely long coffin nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: A thick, heavy, extremely strong man built like a powerlifter. A huge barrel chest, enormously wide shoulders and back, a thick solid waist with a firm rounded belly over strong abs, massive arms, and enormous thick thighs and calves. Every part is large, dense and continuous rather than sharply cut. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain (a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels), wide gold-and-red bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense overglaze florals filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands sweeping his hair back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme black platform stiletto studded boots, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
